name: Acceptor Batch Transfer V 15
definition: The AcceptorBatchTransfer is sent by an acceptor (or its agent) to transfer the financial data of a collection of transactions to the acquirer (or its agent).

BatchTransfer.name: Batch Transfer
BatchTransfer.definition: Card payment transactions from one or several data set of transactions.

SecurityTrailer.name: Security Trailer
SecurityTrailer.definition: Trailer of the message containing a MAC or a digital signature.
